capabilities.why: Snapshots provide instantaneous checkpointing of guest memory and filesystem state prior to risky steps, allowing deterministic rollback when a test run corrupts libraries or environment configuration.

Safety hooks intercept and analyze every command prior to dispatch to the microVM, blocking destructive filesystem modifications, reverse shells, and malicious exfiltration of sensitive tokens before execution.

Network policy isolates guest egress traffic, ensuring that prompt-injected web targets or poisoned test dependencies cannot exfiltrate environment secrets or sensitive repo code to untrusted external endpoints.
